## Tutorials

The LEAST() function returns the smallest value of the list of arguments.

Note:See also theGREATEST()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT LEAST(3, 12, 34, 8, 25);

---

LEAST(
arg1
,
arg2
,
arg3
, ...)

---

SELECT LEAST("w3Schools.com", "microsoft.com", "apple.com");
```

### Code Examples
